result.stdout:
Description:
  Converts an SVG image to an application icon file for the specified platform.

Usage:
  dotnet-icons convert-svg <inFile> <outFile> [options]

Arguments:
  <inFile>   A source SVG file.
  <outFile>  A destination icons file.

Options:
  --platform <platform>  The target platform for the icon file. Must be one of: 'MacOS', 'Windows'.
  -?, -h, --help         Show help and usage information
